brief:
Palestinian Ambassador Husam Zomlot said the UK government has indicated it will impose tougher restrictions on arms sales to Israel, Zeteo reported. Speaking with the outlet, Zomlot discussed new sanctions on illegal West Bank settlements and his personal observations of the conflict.

The ambassador's statement comes as pressure mounts on Western governments to limit military support to Israel amid the ongoing war in Gaza and concerns over settlement expansion in occupied Palestinian territory.
dek: Sitting down with Zeteo UK’s Shehab Khan, Husam Zomlot talks about the new sanctions on illegal settlements in the West Bank and his personal experience of the genocide.
title: UK envoy tells Palestinian ambassador arms curbs on Israel are coming
